name: Rei
source:
A woman who works for "Visitant" administration (a bureau that specialises in handling new arrivals from other worlds. Japanese translation of the term is 訪問者)

She normally works as a librarian at a library close by.

[Translated from [url=http://sukerasparo.com/#chara]Official Site[/url]]
